findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The contract outlines the purpose of the agreement, which includes facilitating a secure, controlled, and confidential exchange of information required to evaluate, plan, carry out, deploy, or support various hardware, technology, manufacturing, integration, compliance, and operational activities relating to the BFSI sector.
evidence_excerpts: for the purpose of facilitating a secure, controlled, and confidential exchange of information required to evaluate, plan, carry out, deploy, or support various hardware, technology, manufacturing, integration, compliance, and operational activities relating to the BFSI sector.

findings.title: Client-Side Obligations for Confidential Information
findings.rationale: The vendor relies on the client to maintain strict confidentiality and protect sensitive information, which is crucial for the performance of their obligations under the contract.
evidence_excerpts: The Receiving Party shall maintain the strictest levels of confidentiality in handling, accessing, storing, processing, transferring, and destroying Confidential Information received from the Disclosing Party.
